title: ADR-0011 identity-actions addendum: record the two SCIM credential actions (mint H, revoke C) that #31032 adds
body:
domain:server#3 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dFb2QdZEHEJ83cR2B

Filing gate: ① a governing record made stale by landed-in-flight work: ADR-0011's addendum "the platform identity actions an agent may reach" says "This table lives only here; a reviewer of `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` reads it" and lists every assessed `sys_*` identity action by bucket (H 23 / C 17 / E 19, "59 actions and 36 `ai` blocks"). PR #31119 (#31032) adds two identity actions on `sys_scim_connection_credential`: `mint_scim_credential`, bucket H (no `ai` block; triage 6692886264: "Classify mint as not exposed to AI tools"), and `revoke_scim_credential`, bucket C (`ai: { exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true }`; triage: "Revoke may be classified on its own merits"). reach: the table is the only record (the maintainer struck an automatic check: 「自动检查 有必要吗？每一个元数据应用都有类似的问题，后续都要检查吗」), so the next reviewer of `identity/**` reads a list that omits a live AI-exposed action.

**Business reason.** The table is the reviewer's only answer to "which platform identity actions can an AI agent run". Once #31119 lands it would understate that set by one exposed action (and one human-only action), which is the kind of drift the addendum exists to prevent.

**Reader.** The `domain:skills` lane (`docs/adr/**`), one Tier H PR with a full Fable review before ACCEPT. It adds the two names to the H and C lists and updates the counts (H 24 / C 18, 61 actions, 37 `ai` blocks), noting the two actions' card (#31032) and the triage classification above. Blocked by: #31032 (PR #31119) landing, so the record matches main.

**Dedupe (open and closed).** `ADR-0011 addendum scim` → 3 hits (#31032 and two seat posts); none carries this.

Suggested-grade: p3 · governance record, no product behaviour change.
